section_summary.extract_value: This section describes preliminary data analyses conducted to assess the suitability of data for further statistical testing. The authors tested normality of distribution using Skewness and Kurtosis coefficients (with BAS-2 showing Skewness of −0.16 and Age showing Kurtosis of 4.52), and checked for multicollinearity using Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) values, all of which indicated acceptable data quality and no serious violations of statistical assumptions.

section_summary.extract_value: This section presents preliminary data analyses and a final path model examining relationships among Age, OAS (Other as Shamer Scale), BMI, SCS_SC (Self-Compassion Scale positive composite), and BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2). The path model shows that BMI has a significant negative relationship with BAS-2 (r = -0.27, p < 0.001), and OAS also negatively predicts BAS-2 (r = -0.42, p < 0.001), while SCS_SC positively predicts BAS-2 (r = 0.34, p < 0.001).
